About.metaDescription: Why GitHub Profile Generator exists and the many ways people can help it grow.
About.eyebrow: A tool shaped by a real need
About.title: A profile is yours to describe.
About.lede: GitHub Profile Generator began with a simple wish: make a profile that could reflect what I wanted to share, in my own way.
About.originStory: I wanted to refresh my GitHub profile, but I couldn't find a tool with enough flexibility to express the things I had in mind. I started this project to make a space where a short introduction, favorite tools, selected work, contributions, and contact links could come together on the writer's terms.
About.productBelief: A profile does not need to prove anything. Public activity is only one part of a person's story, and it is fine to have little or none to show. This editor keeps its sections optional so people can choose what feels right for them.
About.helpEyebrow: Open source is a shared effort
About.helpTitle: There are many ways to take part.
About.helpIntro: You don't need to start with code. A thoughtful report, a clearer explanation, or a recommendation to the right person can all move a project forward.

feedback.title: Help improve the experience
feedback.description: Found a confusing step or something that doesn't work as expected? Describe what happened and what you were trying to do. Ideas for features are welcome too.

build.title: Make something together
build.description: Contribute code, improve documentation, or help make the editor easier to use. The contribution guide explains the setup and review process.

share.title: Help others find it
share.description: If this editor could help someone shape their profile, pass it along. You can also star the repository to make it easier for others to discover.

About.closingDescription: Start with the parts of your profile you want to share. You can leave the rest for another time.
